## ITMockTelegramChat type

Basic Telegram mock chat profile used when generating message updates.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITMockTelegramChat = {
    id?: number;
    type?: `private` | `group` | `supergroup` | `channel`;
    first_name?: string;
    last_name?: string;
    username?: string;
    title?: string;
};
```

## Remarks

Mirrors the Telegram Bot API `Chat` object. Used alongside `ITMockTelegramUser` to construct mock message updates sent to the bot's webhook.
